findings.title: findRawColours flags hex-like id selectors and colour-word class names
findings.detail: RAW_HEX /#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b/ matches selectors such as `#add` or `#face`. RAW_NAME matches `red` inside `.ui-red`, because the hyphen counts as a word boundary. Neither is pinned by a scenario, and a token-only theme with such a selector would be reported.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN a theme line holds a selector such as `#face { color: var(--ui-color-text); }` or `.ui-red { color: var(--ui-color-text); }` THEN findRawColours reports that line as a raw colour.

findings.title: Focus outline on the toast Dismiss button is below 3:1 against the toast background
findings.detail: The global :focus-visible rule draws a var(--ui-color-focus) outline (#1d4ed8) with a 2px offset. Inside a toast that outline sits on --ui-color-toast-bg (#1b1f27), and the ratio is about 2.5:1, below the 3:1 the requirement asks for focus indicators. CONTRAST_PAIRS only checks focus against bg and surface, so no gate catches it. [rejected by agent (CLAUDECODE) (The finding is correct and is a WCAG AA defect: the global :focus-visible outline uses --ui-color-focus #1d4ed8, and inside a toast it is drawn (2px offset) over --ui-color-toast-bg #1b1f27, a contrast of 2.46:1, below the 3:1 the requirement sets for focus (and WCAG 1.4.11 for focus indicators); theme.css has no rule that changes the outline inside a toast. Keep CONTRAST_PAIRS at its 16 pairs, which a frozen scenario pins; fix it in theme.css with an outline colour for focus inside a toast that has at least 3:1 against the toast background, for example --ui-color-toast-text (#ffffff, 16.5:1), with no new token. WHEN the Dismiss button inside a toast has keyboard focus THEN its focus outline colour has a contrast of at least 3:1 against --ui-color-toast-bg.)]
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN the Dismiss button inside a toast has keyboard focus THEN its outline is drawn in --ui-color-focus #1d4ed8 over the toast background #1b1f27, a contrast of about 2.5:1.

findings.title: A repeated toast keeps its old place in the queue
findings.detail: A duplicate push refreshes the expiry but leaves the item in place. When the queue is full, a refreshed old item is still the oldest and is the first dropped, even though it was just re-shown. No scenario pins this down.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN the oldest visible toast is pushed again and then a new distinct toast is pushed into a full queue THEN the refreshed toast keeps its original position and is the one dropped.

findings.title: toast-hover.test.ts reads theme.css without an existsSync assertion first
findings.detail: design.md's test plan asks that a test reading a file created in green first assert with assert.ok that the file exists. This test calls readFileSync at module level, so a missing file fails with ENOENT instead of an assertion.
findings.suggested_fix: Assert existsSync of theme.css inside the test before reading it.

findings.title: findRawColours flags hex-like id selectors and colour-word class names
findings.detail: RAW_HEX /#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b/ matches selectors such as `#add` or `#face`. RAW_NAME matches `red` inside `.ui-red`, because the hyphen counts as a word boundary. Neither is pinned by a scenario, and a token-only theme with such a selector would be reported.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN a theme line holds a selector such as `#face { color: var(--ui-color-text); }` or `.ui-red { color: var(--ui-color-text); }` THEN findRawColours reports that line as a raw colour.

findings.title: Focus outline on the toast Dismiss button is below 3:1 against the toast background
findings.detail: The global :focus-visible rule draws a var(--ui-color-focus) outline (#1d4ed8) with a 2px offset. Inside a toast that outline sits on --ui-color-toast-bg (#1b1f27), and the ratio is about 2.5:1, below the 3:1 the requirement asks for focus indicators. CONTRAST_PAIRS only checks focus against bg and surface, so no gate catches it.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN the Dismiss button inside a toast has keyboard focus THEN its outline is drawn in --ui-color-focus #1d4ed8 over the toast background #1b1f27, a contrast of about 2.5:1.

findings.title: A repeated toast keeps its old place in the queue
findings.detail: A duplicate push refreshes the expiry but leaves the item in place. When the queue is full, a refreshed old item is still the oldest and is the first dropped, even though it was just re-shown. No scenario pins this down.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN the oldest visible toast is pushed again and then a new distinct toast is pushed into a full queue THEN the refreshed toast keeps its original position and is the one dropped.

findings.title: toast-hover.test.ts reads theme.css without an existsSync assertion first
findings.detail: design.md's test plan asks that a test reading a file created in green first assert with assert.ok that the file exists. This test calls readFileSync at module level, so a missing file fails with ENOENT instead of an assertion.
evidence: web/src/kit/toast-hover.test.ts: const THEME = readFileSync(new URL("./theme.css", import.meta.url), "utf8");
findings.suggested_fix: Assert existsSync of theme.css inside the test before reading it.
